## v0.5.8 · Runtime Archive Safety and Review Reliability

This patch release includes the six fixes merged in [#241](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/241), [#242](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/242), [#243](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/243), [#245](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/245), [#246](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/246) and [#247](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/247).

- Preflight Runtime archive destinations, retain exact receipts and compensate only proven-new writes.
- Fall back safely on invalid routing batches while preserving complete original content.
- Stabilize delegated result tool definitions with revocable per-run requests and child ownership checks.
- Prevent composed plugins from bypassing idle-review tool restrictions; reuse complete inherited evidence.
- Surface background review errors in WebUI and logs, including context-window guidance.
- Restore the Mnemon sidebar entry under the ORCA LINK skin.

[#244](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/244) also records fresh regression evidence for legacy Session and WebUI fixes already shipped in v0.5.7.

### Packages and upgrade

Only **dsh-mnemon 0.5.8** is newly published. Its sixteen pinned plugins retain their existing versions. Storage formats and supported DSH peer ranges are unchanged.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.8
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser; substitute `headless` for that Profile. The full DSH profile requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

### 中文说明

本版修复运行时归档预检与失败清理、无效路由整批回退、固定结果工具的并发与生命周期控制、组合插件绕过后台审查工具限制、审查错误不可见，以及 ORCA 皮肤下侧栏入口隐藏。归档保留完整原文与可验证回执，审查复用继承证据。

仅主包发布 0.5.8，十六个插件保持现有固定版本。发布流程验证完整组合、npm 制品完整性和从 v0.4.7 开始的真实升级，再创建此 Release。

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.8/docs/en/releases/v0.5.8.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.8/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.8.md) for verification evidence and the limits of remote-write compensation and model-cache claims.
